name: chembl-pharmacology
title: ChEMBL pharmacology · community regime
description: Approved molecules bridged to human protein targets by mechanism-of-action records. GPU force regime with Louvain communities colouring the molecule/target/mechanism tripartite structure.

name: openalex-citations
title: OpenAlex citations · scale-free regime
description: The most relevant works for one search scope plus the citation edges among them. PageRank sizing makes the citation hubs of the field pop out of the long tail.

name: hindsight-memory
title: Hindsight memory · concentric regime
description: One agent-memory bank as units, entities, and documents. Concentric static layout ranks by degree so canonical entities sit in the core rings.

name: knowledge-docs
title: Jump Cannon docs · doctype regime
description: The deployment's own knowledge corpus, coloured by document type with the wikilink structure under a GPU force regime. Runs on the deployment default source.

name: physics-communities
title: Generated communities · physics regime
description: Four generated communities under the GPU force regime with per-edge springs (short inside a community, long between) and per-node charge doubling from one community to the next. Generated in the browser; needs no server.
